summary:
The New York Times is the newspaper at nytimes.com. The blackletter “T” in the tab is the favicon article bookmarks use, saved from the host response.

Checked 12 November 2026 against nytimes.com. HTML came from https://www.nytimes.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

A request to the favicon.ico URL https://www.nytimes.com/favicon.ico returned png (48×48, 1648 bytes), not an ICO container. Formats that saved: png.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

Brand colour #111111 comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-48x48-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-48x48-01.png at 48×48 (png, 1648 bytes) from https://www.nytimes.com/favicon.ico.
